sql.if: AND ( title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR sql_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR remark LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM sql_snippet WHERE created_by = #{userId} AND category IS NOT NULL AND category <> '' ORDER BY category
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sql_snippet (title, category, db_type, sql_text, remark, created_by) VALUES (#{title}, #{category}, #{dbType}, #{sqlText}, #{remark}, #{createdBy})
